description: Shared, project-based long-term memory and an import-graph code map for Copilot, Claude and Codex.
untrusted: Memory writes files in the workspace and sends its contents to a language model.
config.title: ORVO Memory
config.frequency: How often raw memories (the inbox and new commits) are consolidated into notes.
config.model.vendor: Vendor of the model used for consolidation (for example `copilot`). Leave empty to use the first available model. Use the Select Model command to pick.
config.model.id: ID of the model used for consolidation. Use the Select Model command to pick.
config.learnFromCommits: Also learn from new git commit messages.
config.connectAgents: Whether to add a memory section to CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md so every agent reads and writes the memory.
config.codeMap.enabled: Offer the ORVO Code Map MCP server (the project's import graph) to Copilot, and to Claude and Codex through `.mcp.json` when agents are connected.
view.name: Project Memory
tool.remember.name: Remember
tool.remember.description: Save a fact to the project memory
tool.search.name: Search Memory
